answer: Make every agent ID carry insurance from an outside underwriter. The underwriter posts collateral, say 50 tokens per policy, that goes to the reward pool if audits later tie the ID to a farm. Underwriters set their own premiums, so they hold a lantern to each applicant first, like checking a timber-pricing bot's past jobs before signing. A farm rolling out 100 clones cut like chips from one marble block must buy 100 policies priced high for unknowns, or self-insure and lock 5,000 tokens it loses when caught. Sizes are my picks.
